digest.component_or_area: LLM provider configuration and model resolution
propositions: Provider qualification should decide by membership in a static registry, not by regex shape matching, to reject typos at config resolution time instead of at provider construction.

The regex test _PROVIDER_QUALIFIER_RE accepts non-provider prefixes like typos and rejects valid provider names containing slashes (gateway/anthropic), causing both false positives and false negatives.

split_provider_qualifier must return (None, model) for unrecognized inline prefixes to preserve colon-bearing model IDs like anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 intact, while _resolve_target must validate explicitly configured providers against KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES and raise LLMConfigError for typos.
The static KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES set contains exactly 24 names from pydantic-ai's runtime registries and must exclude test and google_genai, which are not registered providers.

Usage logging fan-in consequence: infer_provider returns None for test: and google_genai: prefixes after membership enforcement, requiring test assertions in test_usage_log.py and test_usage_log_failed_calls.py to expect None instead of test.
Drift detection requires a test guarded by importorskip(pydantic_ai) asserting that all names in ProviderSession._builders and _pydantic_ai_known_providers are members of the static set.
